title: Plan contradicted epic.md acceptance criteria without acknowledging the deviation
description: Epic.md specified 'semgrep --config auto . reports no high-severity findings' as an acceptance criterion. The plan changed this to 'pin SemGrep to a specific versioned ruleset' without acknowledging the deviation from the spec. The existing CI already uses --config auto successfully. A swarm worker following the plan would change CI to use a pinned ruleset, breaking alignment with the epic.md acceptance criteria. Similar contradictions existed for 'Ant Design or MUI' (plan chose MUI only) and compose-level criteria owned by Epic 1.
root_cause: plan_phase_epic applies its own best-practice judgment (pinning for reproducibility) without checking whether it contradicts the epic.md acceptance criteria. It doesn't have a validation step that compares plan success criteria against epic.md acceptance criteria to flag deviations.
recommendation: Add a validation step to plan_phase_epic: after generating Success Criteria, cross-reference each criterion against the epic.md Acceptance Criteria. If the plan deviates from an epic.md criterion, it must: (1) explicitly note the deviation, (2) provide justification, (3) mark which epic.md criteria are 'covered as-is', 'modified with justification', or 'deferred to another epic'.
affected_section: Success Criteria generation and epic.md cross-validation.
plan_context: Phase 1 Epic 2 — Tech Stack Standards, semgrep configuration
